semantic.justification: Pinned available single-byte conversion descriptors and string conversion flags, native UTF-8 conversion in both directions, exact UTF-8 allocation estimate/ASCII fast path/retry loop and source final FLUSH. UTF-16 and broader registry/constructor contracts remain independently unverified. OUStringToOString now delegates to actual rtl_uString2String ownership/conversion instead of a duplicated single-byte/UTF8-only shortcut. Returned bytes are copied from the logical native byte string before releasing its owner. All represented multibyte/contextual reverse owners are reachable through the factory; native ISCII null-context mismatch remains preserved rather than concealed. Existing little-endian UTF16 adapter is retained. OStringToOUString still awaits the native forward string-wrapper owner; complete SAL registry and value-class ABI remain unverified.
